backend/main.mo: Main canister actor implementing access control, blob storage mixins, user profiles, a follow system, and a studies subsystem with create/join/query operations.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old and new type structures and data transformation logic for upgrading stored canister state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend config, hooks, components, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and global base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file bootstrapping the app and loading the main React entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app with authentication gating, profile setup logic, and full route definitions using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAllUs: Admin panel placeholder card indicating that full user listing is unavailable and directing admins to use search.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUserC: Displays an admin read‑only view of a user's conversations, including conversation list, message history, and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUserM: Allows admins to view a user's profile and role and perform moderation actions such as verify, ban/unban, and toggle teacher badge.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUsers: Provides user search, selection, and navigation to moderation and conversation panels, plus a tab to view all users.
frontend/src/components/admin/RequireAdm: Guards pages by verifying admin access and shows an access‑denied message if unauthorized.
Implements the login screen using Internet Identity with branding, loading states, and error display.
frontend/src/components/common/TeacherBa: Renders a small red teacher badge icon for marking teacher accounts.
frontend/src/components/common/VerifiedA: Displays a user avatar with optional verified and teacher badge overlays.
frontend/src/components/common/VerifiedB: Renders a blue verified check badge icon.
frontend/src/components/events/EventForm: A form for creating events with validation, input fields, and submit/cancel handling.
frontend/src/components/feed/UserSearchR: Displays user search results with loading, error, empty state, and navigation to profiles.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout including header, footer, bottom nav, and story dialog handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Renders a mobile bottom navigation bar with dynamic admin items and active route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/learn/DailyItemC: Shows a styled card presenting a daily word title and content using UnicodeText.
frontend/src/components/learn/LearnCreat: Provides a dialog form for creating lessons, handling validation, submission, and reset.
frontend/src/components/messages/Sticker: Displays a sticker from a sprite sheet based on ID and size.
Renders a popover sticker picker allowing selection from the sticker sheet.
frontend/src/components/posts/CommentsPa: Shows a list of comments and provides a form to submit new comments.
frontend/src/components/posts/PostCard.t: Displays a post with author info, media, like handling, and optional comments panel toggle.
frontend/src/components/posts/UnicodeTex: Simple component that renders Unicode text with wrapping and optional class styling.
frontend/src/components/profile/AvatarUp: Handles image selection and upload for user avatars with validation and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/CountryC: Renders a select dropdown of country calling codes for phone number input.
frontend/src/components/profile/Follower: Displays a modal listing followers or following users with profile data and navigation.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Provides a dropdown menu for viewing and editing the current user's profile and follower lists.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal for initial profile creation with name, location, and phone validation before saving.
frontend/src/components/stories/AddStory: Dialog to upload and preview an image story, handle validation, and submit it to the backend.
frontend/src/components/stories/StoriesR: Displays a horizontal list of story circles for the user and followed accounts with grouping logic.
frontend/src/components/stories/StoryVie: Full-screen dialog component for viewing story media with navigation, author info, and progress indicators.
frontend/src/config/brand.ts: Defines static branding metadata such as app name, tagline, and description.
frontend/src/config/featuredCreators.ts: Provides a temporary allowlist of featured creator principals and a helper to check membership.
frontend/src/config/highlights.ts: Declares curated highlight channel categories with IDs, names, descriptions, and icons.
frontend/src/config/stickers.ts: Defines sticker metadata and positions for a 3x2 sticker sheet plus its asset path.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to user identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, state, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasswordActor.ts: Empty placeholder file for password-based actor logic.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasswordAuth.tsx: Empty placeholder file for password-based auth logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching user profiles, public profiles, and related backend data.
frontend/src/hooks/useReelsAutoplay.ts: Watches reel elements via IntersectionObserver to track which reel is actively visible.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom light/dark earth-tone theme variables and font settings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, global CSS, and renders the app.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard providing forms to create events, lessons, and assign posts to channels, with related state handling and mutations.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelPage.tsx: Displays posts for a selected highlight channel with navigation, loading states, and authenticated create-post action.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: One‑to‑one chat interface fetching messages, user profiles, sending text or sticker messages, and auto‑scrolling conversation view.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Form for creating posts with caption and optional media upload, supporting channels and event‑linked posts with progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/CreateReelsPage.tsx: Page for uploading and publishing video‑only reels with preview and upload progress handling.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailsPage.tsx: Shows event details and its associated posts, with create‑post option for authenticated users and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Displays a list of community events, supports admin event creation, and shows loading or empty states. Handles adding events with a modal form and converts dates to nanoseconds.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Renders the community feed with posts, stories, and user search. Supports creating posts, viewing stories, and searching users by display name.
frontend/src/pages/HighlightsPage.tsx: Shows curated highlight channels and a showcase link using a grid of navigable cards. Provides quick access to themed cultural content.
frontend/src/pages/LearnPage.tsx: Lists lessons and a daily learning item, with admin/teacher ability to add new content. Allows navigation to individual lesson pages.
frontend/src/pages/LessonPage.tsx: Displays a single lesson with title, content, and optional media. Handles loading, not-found state, and navigation back to the lessons list.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Shows messages section, prompting login if unauthenticated. If logged in, displays an empty conversations placeholder.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileEditPage.tsx: Provides a form for editing user profile details including display name, phone, location, and avatar. Performs validation and saves updates via backend mutation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders a user profile page with follow/unfollow, messaging, admin visibility rules, and follower/following dialogs. Fetches profile data, posts, and permissions and handles navigation and private field visibility.
frontend/src/pages/ReelsPage.tsx: Displays full-screen vertical video reels with autoplay, mute controls, and author info. Loads posts, filters for video media, and manages active reel playback.
frontend/src/pages/ShowcasePage.tsx: Shows a grid of featured creators derived from posts, linking each to their profile. Displays loading state and handles the empty state when no creators qualify.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Converts backend error messages into user-friendly strings. Matches known error patterns and falls back to the raw message when unmatched.
frontend/src/utils/phoneValidation.ts: Validates and normalizes phone numbers by checking digit-only content and length constraints. Provides simple error messages for invalid inputs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL or session-based parameters. Supports hash-based routing and persistent parameter storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, plugins, and scanning paths. Adds custom OKLCH color variables, fonts, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Describes current project state including regression issues, feature restoration requirements, and pending admin-related feature requests.
